title: AXI R-Channel VALID/READY Backpressure
description: The subordinate is the R-channel source: after asserting RVALID it holds RVALID and the complete R payload stable until a rising edge accepts the beat with RVALID and RREADY HIGH.

annotations.message: The subordinate asserts RVALID without waiting for RREADY. Because RREADY is LOW, no read beat is accepted.
The stall continues. The subordinate holds RVALID and the complete R payload stable.
RVALID and RREADY are both HIGH at this rising edge, so the read-data beat is accepted now.
